subtext: Built, rebuilt and tested by engineers who work on Jaguar engines every day.
Here's our practical view of the AJ25 across all six model applications.

columns.title: APPLICATIONS WE SEE:
columns.body: The AJ25 is a relatively new engine, and we see it across the entire range of its applications — from the compact 45-series Jaguars to the more recent 43-series models and the AJ25.

columns.title: WHAT WE REPLACE:
columns.body: Bearings, timing chain components, gaskets, and twin-scroll turbocharger components as standard. We also inspect and measure the cylinder head, crankshaft, and other critical components.

columns.title: KNOWN ISSUES:
columns.body: No widely-reported pattern is confirmed for the AJ25 across any of its six applications. We don't treat this engine as having one universal failure mode; diagnosis is required to establish whether an engine needs repair, rebuild, or replacement.

notice.rest: engine-specific case studies with real job details are not yet included on this page — they'll be added once a documented set of completed AJ25 rebuilds is available to draw from, rather than filled with placeholder examples now.

typical.title: JAGUAR AJ25 REBUILD
typical.intro: The following describes a typical rebuild scope for this engine — illustrative of the work involved, not a specific customer job. Real case studies from our own completed work will replace this section once available.
typical.body: The AJ25 is a highly-strung, high-performance engine, and its twin-scroll turbocharger is a central component in its design. A full rebuild involves removing and inspecting the turbocharger, replacing timing chain components, bearings, gaskets, and calibrating the two-stage fuel injection system (direct and port injection). Given its 421 hp output in S guise, the engine's components are stressed to a high degree, and we pay particular attention to the crankshaft and cylinder head during inspection.

scope.label: Typical Scope:
scope.text: Timing chain, bearings, gaskets, twin-scroll turbocharger inspection/refurbishment, calibration of fuel injection system
